coding.note: I only coded claims from the abstract and introduction. The 'novel reinforcement learning algorithm' on p5 is outside those sections, so I didn't code it as a claim. There are no ARCH or TRAIN contribution claims, so ablation is NA throughout. The architecture choices (MQA, RoPE, GeGLU, RMSNorm) are presented as existing techniques, not new ones. MQA is described as chosen 'based on ablations', but no ablation results are shown. The confidence intervals in Table 5 are computed over prompts, not over training runs, so seeds is NR. The report gives hardware (4096 TPUv5e for 7B, 512 for 2B) and carbon (~131 tCO2eq) but no training duration, GPU/TPU-hours or FLOPs, so compute_disclosed is N (conservative). Main table: Mistral entries marked * were run by the authors and the rest are from reports, while LLaMA-2 scores are copied, so rerun and scores_copied are MIXED. Third-party: HuggingFace ran the H6 evaluations in Table 7. The third_party quote crosses a two-column interleave in the extracted text. It is contiguous in the page text after whitespace normalisation.
